separationOfDuties: The task owner cannot approve completion; a named reviewer must issue PASS.
dependencyRule: All dependsOn tasks must be Completed before work can enter Ready or In Progress.
assignmentPolicy: Unfinished engineering work is balanced between Codex and Claude. The opposite agent is always the peer reviewer; domain, product, security, and release reviewers remain additional reviewers where applicable.
pullPolicy: Each agent uses claim-next to pull its highest-priority Ready task. Ownership can be reassigned only before implementation starts and every reassignment is audited.
